display.purpose: Name, section titles, prices, and the unlock button.

body.purpose: Reading text and the form. Required by the brief.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: One screen-print settle on the brick key. Off when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Unlock button
components.description: Full-width ink button. The words are the control: unlock the door.
components.css: .ds-unlock { width: 100%; min-height: 4.5rem; border: 0; background: #1E1414; color: #F3EBDD; font-family: "Abril Fatface", Palatino, serif; font-size: 2rem; cursor: pointer; padding: 0.6rem 1rem 0.75rem; } .ds-unlock:hover { background: #9E2B25; } .ds-unlock:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9E2B25; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Paper card
components.description: Square paper card with a brick top edge. Used for revamp and new build.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #EADFCC; color: #1E1414; border-top: 0.4rem solid #9E2B25; padding: 1.25rem 1.3rem 1.4rem; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { font-family: "Abril Fatface", Palatino, serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.7rem; margin: 0 0 0.45rem; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Square ink-stroked field on the warm paper fill.
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 0.35rem; color: #1E1414; } .ds-field { width: 100%; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: 0.75rem 0.85rem; border: 1.5px solid #1E1414; background: #E7D9C4; color: #1E1414; font: 1rem Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9E2B25; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Work plate
components.description: Empty circular plate. Label stays project coming soon until real work exists.
components.css: .ds-plate { width: 10rem; height: 10rem; border: 2px solid #1E1414; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; text-align: center; background: #F7F1E7; color: #1E1414; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; padding: 1.15rem; position: relative; } .ds-plate::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0.45rem; border: 1.5px solid #9E2B25; border-radius: 50%; transform: translate(3px, -3px); }

components.name: Section label
components.description: Tracked brick label from the deck, set above a heading.
components.css: .ds-kicker { margin: 0 0 0.4rem; color: #9E2B25; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview: Two Keys reads as one sheet of cream paper. Brick is the only accent. The crossed keys are the offer: creative direction and build-and-care, one door. Nothing on the page is a claim the pitch deck did not make.
keyCharacteristics: Cream paper, warm black, one brick
Flat print: rules, square fields, no shadow
Crossed keys with a slight misregistration

rules.name: One brick
rules.body: Brick is the accent and the close. It is not a second theme and it is not used as small text on ink.

rules.name: Deck copy only
rules.body: Prices stay $___ and contact stays coming soon until the owner fills them in. No invented clients.

dos: Do keep the crossed keys as the mark.
Do use square fields and hairline rules.
donts: Don't invent testimonials, clients, or prices.
